data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 25.445m at the start of 2017 and recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 8.936m (approximately 35.1% of opening reserves). This release is shown in the technical provisions movement as an "over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses" and reflects favourable claims development and the absence of major prior-year adverse activity. The syndicate is a quota-share reinsurance vehicle (property catastrophe reinsurance), so the impact is concentrated in its reinsurance/treaty business. Named 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria) materially impacted the 2017 year but the prior-year movement reported was a release.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) sourced from the Technical Provisions note row 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (gross column). Named 2017 catastrophe events are mentioned but not individually quantified for Syndicate 6104. LOB mapping uses 'Treaty' (syndicate is a quota-share reinsurer) / 'Reinsurance - Property' inference. Claims development triangle is available (gross, in thousands) and was used for cross-checks but the explicit gross PYD figure was taken from the provision movement table.
